Q. 1 غَلْصَمَهُ , (S, TA,) inf. n. غَلْصَمَةٌ, (K, TA,) He cut, or severed, his غَلْصَمَة [here app. meaning larynx, or upper part of the windpipe: compare حَلْقَمَهُ]. (S, K, * TA.) ―
-b2- And He took hold of, or laid hold upon, or seized, his غَلْصَمَة [here, likewise, app. meaning as expl. above: see the pass. part. n., below]. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
